Title: Ophidian Gaze and post-referendum action modifiers

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Hello!

How far in time does 'after blocks are declined' reach?

Can I use it to cancel Voter Captivation "after resolution of a successful referendum"?

Can I use it to cancel Freak Drive "after resolution of an action"?

Name: Ophidian Gaze
[TU:C]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Presence & Serpentis
Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
Only usable during a political action, after blocks are declined. Cancel an action modifier as it is played, and its cost is not paid.
Artist: Ginés Quiñonero

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Kraus wrote:
> Hello!
>
> How far in time does 'after blocks are declined' reach?
>
Until the end of the action.

> rulebook wrote:
> Action modifiers and reaction cards can be played at any time before resolution during an action (unless otherwise noted on card text), with the acting Methuselah getting the opportunity to play first.
>
> Kraus wrote:
> Can I use it to cancel Voter Captivation "after resolution of a successful referendum"?
>
> Can I use it to cancel Freak Drive "after resolution of an action"?
>
Please note that both are the same window. The answer is: yes.
